facts.business: Manglam Global Corporations Limited (formerly Kshitij Investments Limited) is engaged in procurement of agricultural produce directly from farmers through APMC and related trading activities.

auditor.name: M/s. A K B Jain & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Pending updation of revised company name and business objectives on BSE portal; 2) Cash payments to farmers for agricultural procurement under Rule 6DD exceptions; 3) Related party loan of Rs 4.70 crore remitted through cash credit facility without formal interest rate and repayment schedule documentation.

key_risks: Pending BSE updation of name change and business objectives
Cash payments to farmers without formal internal approval and documentation
Related party loan of Rs 4.70 crore with unspecified interest rate and repayment terms, remitted through cash credit facility
No tangible or intangible assets held by the company
Inventory of only Rs 21,475 as at March 31, 2026
facts.related_party_note: Loan of Rs 4,70,00,000 granted to a related party during the year, outstanding carrying amount including accrued interest is Rs 4,72,08,899 as at March 31, 2026. Loan remitted through cash credit facility. Shareholder approval obtained but without specified interest rate and repayment schedule. Interest income recognized and TDS deducted. Management seeking formal ratification.
